independentLayers.description: Locale parsing and formatNumber display, stepping (step, small and large steps, snap, clamp), stepper ARIA and the press-and-hold and scrub gestures, shared by both renderers.
Label, description and error wiring (ids, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-invalid).
Reference numbers for the number-field family.

intent: Enter or adjust a number, such as a quantity, a price or a dimension, by typing, stepping or dragging, formatted for the locale

properties.description: Form field name; the host submits the number (not the formatted text) under this name, empty when there is none.
Blocks interaction and submission; the steppers and scrub area stop. An ancestor <fieldset disabled> or ui-fieldset disables it too.
Requires a value. The error shows only after the user leaves the field or a submit is blocked.
Visible label text, in the scrub area; names the input. Without it supply aria-label or a wrapping ui-field.
The live number, or null when the field is empty (Base UI value). The value attribute at connect is the reset default.
Base UI defaultValue: the value at first render (when no value is set) and on form reset.
Lowest value: a commit clamps to it (unless allow-out-of-range), the decrement stops there, Home goes there.
Highest value: a commit clamps to it (unless allow-out-of-range), the increment stops there, End goes there.
Amount per arrow key, stepper press or scrub step (Base UI step, default 1); its decimals widen the displayed fraction digits.
Amount with Alt held (Base UI smallStep, default 0.1).
Amount with Shift held (Base UI largeStep, default 10).
Steps and commits snap to multiples of step from min (or 0) (Base UI snapOnStep).
A typed value outside min / max is kept on blur and marked invalid (rangeUnderflow / rangeOverflow) instead of clamped (Base UI allowOutOfRange).
The wheel steps the value while the input is focused and the pointer is over the group (Base UI allowWheelScrub).
The scrub area's axis: horizontal (right increases, mirrored in RTL) or vertical (up increases) (Base UI ScrubArea direction).
Pixels dragged on the scrub area per step (Base UI ScrubArea pixelSensitivity, default 2).

Intl.NumberFormat options for the text (Base UI format): an object, or JSON in the attribute; through formatNumber (U+2212 minus, narrow no-break spaces). Default: decimal with up to 3 fraction digits (more when step has more).
BCP 47 locale for formatting and parsing (Base UI locale); default the runtime's.
Text shown while the field is empty.
Help text under the control, wired with aria-describedby.
Author error, shown immediately and marking the field invalid.
The value can be read and focused but not changed: no typing, steppers, scrub or wheel; data-readonly.
Ids (space-separated) that name the input when label is empty (a wrapping ui-field sets it).
Ids (space-separated) that describe the input, after its own description and error (a wrapping ui-field sets it).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: hide-label
attributes.description: Keeps the label as the input's accessible name but does not draw it (the scrub area is visually hidden, out of flow). data-hide-label is the same input; React: hideLabel.

events.name: input
events.trigger: the value changes: typing text that parses, emptying it, a paste, a commit that clamps or snaps, a key step, a stepper press (and each repeat while held), a scrub step, a wheel step
events.detail: { value: number | null, reason: 'input-change' | 'input-clear' | 'input-paste' | 'input-blur' | 'keyboard' | 'increment-press' | 'decrement-press' | 'scrub' | 'wheel', event: Event } (Base UI onValueChange)

events.name: change
events.trigger: a commit with a value different from the last one: blur or Enter after typing, a key step, a stepper or scrub release, a wheel step
events.detail: { value: number | null, reason, event } (Base UI onValueCommitted; reasons as for input, input-blur for a typed commit)

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation; fires invalid when it fails.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Marks the field touched (errors show) and reports.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description: Sets an author error; an empty string clears it.

methods.name: stepBy
methods.description: Steps the value as a stepper press does (fires input and change).

semantics.formValue: the number as a string, empty when there is none

keyboard.action: step by step (Shift: large-step, Alt: small-step), clamped to min / max; commits
go to min / max when set; commits
commit (parse, clamp, snap, reformat), then request submit of the owning form

content.children: Optional text adornments with slot="prefix" | "suffix" ("$", "kg"); they move into the group beside the input. Authored [data-part] parts (scrub-area › label, group › decrement · prefix · input · suffix · increment, description, error) are adopted (composition). Other children are discarded by the template.

constraints: template() owns the children: scrub area (label), group ([decrement] [prefix] [input] [suffix] [increment]), description, error. Contains no native form elements: the input is a contenteditable role=textbox, the steppers role=button spans (tabindex −1, aria-label Increase / Decrease, aria-controls the input); form participation goes through ElementInternals (UIFormElement).

The text is formatNumber of the value with format and locale; parsing reads the locale's digits and separators, U+2212 or a hyphen for minus, and ignores the currency, unit and percent text the format writes (a percent format divides by 100). Characters that cannot be part of a number are refused while typing and dropped from a paste.

Typing sets the value as soon as the text parses (no clamping yet); blur or Enter commits: clamp to min / max unless allow-out-of-range, snap with snap-on-step, reformat. input fires per change, change per commit.
Stepping (keys, steppers, scrub, wheel) starts from the text being typed when it parses, else the value (0 when empty), is clamped to min / max and avoids binary noise (0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3).
A stepper at the limit it moves toward is data-disabled and aria-disabled; disabled and read-only stop every gesture.

Composition: the parts may be authored as [data-part] children; the host adopts each onto its generated part (attributes, classes; stepper content replaces the glyph, prefix / suffix content appends; label, description and error text seed those properties). React: NumberField.Root with NumberField.ScrubArea › NumberField.Label, NumberField.Group (prefix, suffix props) › NumberField.Decrement, NumberField.Input, NumberField.Increment, NumberField.Description, NumberField.Error; every React part takes render and className; the React Root renders a hidden input with the number for the form.

avoidWhen.when: Picking a position in a range where the exact number matters less than where it sits.
avoidWhen.reason: A range is a slider with a visible track.

avoidWhen.when: Free text that happens to contain digits (a phone number, a postal code, an id).
avoidWhen.reason: Those are not quantities: stepping, clamping and locale formatting would corrupt them.

avoidWhen.when: Choosing from a few known values.
avoidWhen.reason: A select or segmented control constrains the value to authored options.

nodes.summary: The scrub area (Base UI NumberField.ScrubArea) holding the label: drag it to step the value (pixel-sensitivity px per step, scrub-direction); data-scrubbing while dragging. Hidden without a label.

Base UI NumberField.ScrubAreaCursor: while a mouse drag holds the pointer locked to the scrub area, an icon in the top layer at the virtual pointer (--ui-scrub-x / -y, wrapping at the viewport's edges); hidden otherwise. Authored content replaces the arrows.
The visible label; names the input (aria-labelledby). A press focuses the input.

The field control (Base UI NumberField.Group): 8u, pad u − B, [decrement] [prefix] [input] [suffix] [increment]. A press outside the steppers and input focuses the input; the focus ring paints here; the wheel steps here with allow-wheel-scrub.
The decrement stepper (Base UI NumberField.Decrement) in the leading 6u slot: role=button, not a tab stop, aria-label Decrease; a press steps down and repeats while held. data-disabled at min.
The contenteditable role=textbox input (Base UI NumberField.Input; aria-roledescription Number field, data-numeric tabular figures), 1u from each stepper. The input getter returns it.
The increment stepper (Base UI NumberField.Increment) in the trailing 6u slot: role=button, not a tab stop, aria-label Increase; a press steps up and repeats while held. data-disabled at max.
